Decision to make
You support an operations analysis team. Compare whole-document and sentence-level retrieval on a policy exception.

Core concept
Chunking trades context against noise. Splitting conditions from exceptions can change meaning. Overlap preserves continuity but duplicates evidence and increases retrieval volume.

Practice contract
Rank three supplied snippets against 'approval required' by token overlap, then by ID for ties.

Evidence and boundary
Show normal, missing and uncertain cases. No real data or external actions.

Review and reflect
Separating an exception from its condition
